T: Blue soup. Big knickers. Big heart.
D: A thirty-something Londoner keeps a diary of her love life as she falls between her boss and a stiff lawyer.
P: Serve the mains when Bridget cooks her birthday dinner and the soup turns blue.
S: Una Alconbury's New Year's Day turkey curry buffet

Leftover turkey or chicken tossed in a mild curry mayo with sultanas and spring onion, spooned onto crackers. Shred 300g cooked turkey breast or chicken. Mix 100g whole egg mayo with 2 tbsp Greek yoghurt, 2 tsp mild curry powder, 1 tbsp mango chutney and a squeeze of lemon. Fold in the turkey, 40g sultanas and 2 sliced spring onions and season. Spoon onto 24 crackers or crisp poppadom pieces just before serving and scatter with chopped coriander and toasted flaked almonds.
Shortcrust tartlets baked at 190C for 12 minutes, filled with goat's cheese and caramelised onion.
Bridget's capers in her birthday menu
Baguette slices toasted and spread with cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, capers and lemon zest.
M: the leek soup that turns blue from the string

Silky leek and potato soup finished with cream, topped with crispy fried leek and chive oil, with crusty bread. Definitely not blue. Slice 3 leeks and soften in 60g butter with 500g diced potatoes for 10 minutes without browning. Add 1L chicken stock and simmer 25 minutes until the potato is very soft. Blend until smooth, stir in 150ml cream and season with salt and white pepper. Fry thin strips of the green leek tops in hot oil until crisp, and blitz chives with 3 tbsp olive oil. Serve the soup with a swirl of cream, the chive oil, crispy leeks and buttered crusty bread. Tie the leeks with kitchen twine, not blue string.
Mark Darcy's gruyère and chive omelette
Mark Darcy rescuing the birthday dinner, reindeer jumper long gone

Three-egg omelettes cooked in butter, filled with gruyère and chives, folded onto warm plates with a green salad. Make one at a time. Beat 3 eggs with a pinch of salt. Melt 15g butter in a 20cm non-stick pan over medium-high heat until foaming. Pour in the eggs and stir quickly with a spatula for 20 seconds, then let it set for 30 seconds until just soft on top. Scatter 30g grated gruyère and chives over one half, fold and slide onto a warm plate. Repeat for 4. Serve with rocket dressed in lemon and oil.
W: the orange marmalade on Bridget's birthday menu
Steamed sponge pudding with orange marmalade in the bottom of the bowl, steamed 90 minutes and turned out with custard.
K: Bridget's diary, alcohol units counted daily

Chilled chardonnay with sliced peach, orange and a splash of peach nectar and soda, poured over ice. Sparkling apple and peach for non-drinkers. Slice 2 ripe peaches and 1 orange into a big jug. Add 750ml chilled chardonnay, 200ml peach nectar and 2 tbsp honey and stir. Chill for at least 1 hour. Fill 4 wine glasses with ice and fruit from the jug, pour in the sangria and top with a splash of soda water. For non-drinkers, swap the wine for sparkling apple juice.

s.how: Cook 3 sliced onions slowly with a spoon of brown sugar and thyme for 30 minutes. Cut shortcrust into rounds and press into a patty tin. Bake at 190C for 12 minutes, then fill with the onions and a piece of goat's cheese and bake 5 more minutes.

s.note: Bridget's capers in her birthday menu
s.how: Slice a baguette and toast until golden. Spread with cream cheese, top with folds of smoked salmon, a scatter of capers and a little lemon zest. Serve on a plate at a dinner party where at least one thing will go badly.

w.how: Spoon 4 tbsp orange marmalade into a greased pudding basin. Beat 125g butter with 125g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 175g self-raising flour. Spoon on top, cover tightly and steam for 90 minutes. Turn out and serve with hot custard.
